title: Probing Multimodal Large Language Models on Cognitive Biases in Chinese Short-Video Misinformation

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting varying levels of engagement statistics (views, likes, shares, comments) into the prompts to measure whether models are more likely to trust and validate misinformation when it appears to be highly popular.

Manipulating and permuting the channel IDs and verification statuses (unverified, individual, enterprise, organization) provided to the models to evaluate if they disproportionately trust content from authoritative-seeming sources regardless of factual accuracy.
